task.population: The phlebotomy-weighted complete-measurement domain of nonpregnant women aged 20–44 in NHANES August 2021–August 2023; RIDEXPRG=2, both measured hemoglobin and raw ferritin, positive phlebotomy weight. Pregnancy unknown/incomplete excluded; no CRP restriction. Equal-weight virtual rows represent this domain only under explicit transport assumptions. No individual measurements or target outcome summaries are supplied.

excluded_cohorts: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey

requested_analyses.question: Crude odds ratio for Hb <12 g/dL among raw ferritin <15 ug/L versus ferritin >=15 ug/L; do not adjust for other variables.
requested_analyses.operator: For cells a=both low,b=Hb low only,c=ferritin low only,d=neither: (a*d)/(b*c). If any cell is zero, report not estimable with no continuity correction.

requested_analyses.question: What fraction has both Hb <12 g/dL and raw ferritin <15 ug/L?
requested_analyses.operator: a/n on exactly the same rows.

requested_analyses.question: How strongly do the continuous Hb and raw ferritin measurements rank together?
requested_analyses.operator: Spearman correlation with average ranks for ties on the same rows; constant ranks are not estimable.

context.title: Iron, Folate, and B12 Deficiencies and their Associations with Anemia among Women of Childbearing Age in a Rural Area in Northern China
context.population: Xianghe County, China, June 2004; 1671 nonpregnant/nonlactating parous women 2–4 years postpartum using IUD contraception. Chronic disease, prescription medications and recent multivitamin use excluded as specified in Methods.
context.overlap: Tables I and IV describe the same women, not independent samples. Source study is not the NHANES target.
context.measurement: Duplicate fasting venous HemoCue Hb; raw EDTA plasma ferritin by Randox immunoturbidimetry. Hb g/L divided by 10 gives g/dL. Ferritin ug/L is the admitted interpretation from the explicit Table I cutoff and Tables III/IV.
caveats: Source/target population, assay, parity, postpartum and contraceptive selection differ; no transfer function is identified.

Table I Hb location is inconsistently labelled mean/geometric mean; its numerical value is omitted. Ferritin header and one Methods cutoff contain unit-printing inconsistencies; admitted units follow explicit threshold/table labels.
Broad printed concentration intervals have unclear construction and are omitted; do not treat them as SD or SE.
Source sampling/weighting details do not identify target weights or target conditional relationships. Model and transport uncertainty are not sampling variation.
Only selected source fields are provided in this controlled experiment. Omitted relationships are unknown, not zero or independent. No continuous rank coefficient is supplied.
